about.en: 币安人生 ("Binance Life") is a community-run (CTO) Chinese-language meme token on BNB Chain, launched through Four.meme and named after a phrase Binance co-founder He Yi posted on X. It is the BEP-20 token at 0x924fa68a0FC644485b8df8AbfA0A41C2e7744444; some venues list it under the ticker BNBLIFE. It is not issued or endorsed by Binance.
